statement.excerpt: Yet I believe generative AI is going to lead several of these companies to ruin.

from_speaker: generative AI is going to lead
our_interpretation: 'Several' is read as at least three companies.
The contextual targets are major technology and AI companies discussed in the post, including Google/Alphabet, Meta, Microsoft, and OpenAI.
'Ruin' means insolvency, liquidation, or a lasting collapse of the company as a viable business.
Generative AI must be a substantial documented cause, rather than merely an activity of a company that subsequently failed.
No deadline or accounting measure is supplied.
criteria.support_condition: At least three companies within the contextual target group suffer documented financial ruin substantially caused by their generative-AI activities.
criteria.contradiction_condition: There is no finite-date failure condition for this open-ended forecast. Continued operation, profits, or losses alone cannot conclusively contradict it.
